youtubeDirect.toggle: Large video: upload straight to YouTube
youtubeDirect.toggleHint: For videos over 50 MB. The file goes from your browser to YouTube: it isn't stored in Kreo and only works for YouTube.
youtubeDirect.repick: Choose the file “{name}” ({size}) again on this device to upload it.
youtubeDirect.smallFile: This video fits in Kreo (50 MB or less): you can also upload it to the library under “Media” and use it on every network.
youtubeDirect.otherPlatforms: This video can NOT go to Instagram or TikTok: they need their own media from the library (max 50 MB).
youtubeDirect.lengthLimit: If your channel isn't verified, YouTube only accepts videos up to 15 minutes. Verify it on YouTube to upload longer videos.
youtubeDirect.scheduleNative: With a date and “Public” privacy, YouTube keeps it private and publishes it itself at that time (“Scheduled on YouTube”). With “Unlisted” or “Private” it's uploaded right away with that privacy.
youtubeDirect.cancelConfirm: Cancel the upload? What's been uploaded so far will be lost.
youtubeDirect.needsApprover: This video is uploaded by whoever approves (admin or owner): save and submit for approval. That person will need to choose the same file on their device.
youtubeDirect.dontClose: Don't close or reload this tab until the upload finishes.
youtubeDirect.doneWarnings: Video uploaded, but an optional step failed (thumbnail or playlist). Check it in YouTube Studio.

errors.invalid_input: Check the file: it has to be a video.
errors.too_big: YouTube doesn't accept files over 256 GB.
errors.forbidden: Only an admin or the owner can approve and upload this video.
errors.not_found: Post not found. Save it first.
errors.not_direct: Turn on “Large video: upload straight to YouTube” and save.
errors.not_approved: The post must be approved before uploading the video.
errors.already_uploaded: This video was already uploaded to YouTube for this post.
errors.file_mismatch: That file isn't the one that was approved (different size or type). Choose the same file or approve again.
errors.reconnect: The YouTube connection has expired. Go to Accounts and reconnect YouTube.
errors.quota: YouTube's daily upload limit (API quota) has been reached. Try again tomorrow.
errors.upload_limit: Your channel has exceeded the number of uploads YouTube allows right now. Try again later.
errors.invalid_publish_at: YouTube doesn't accept that publish date. Choose a future date.
errors.invalid_metadata: YouTube rejected the title, description, tags or category. Please review them.
errors.not_on_channel: The video wasn't found on the connected channel.
errors.too_long: YouTube rejected the video because of its length: unverified channels are limited to 15 minutes.
errors.rejected: YouTube rejected the video (format, size or length not allowed). Check it in YouTube Studio.
errors.expired: The upload session expired. Press “Upload to YouTube” again to start over.
errors.interrupted: The upload was interrupted (connection). Press “Resume upload” to continue where it stopped.
errors.bad_response: YouTube returned something unexpected. Check YouTube Studio before trying again.
errors.generic: The upload couldn't be completed. Please try again.
